title: Safety and Efficacy of Devices Used in Fetoscopic Neural Tube Defect Repair Cases
official: Safety and Efficacy of Devices Used in Fetoscopic Neural Tube Defect Repair Cases
summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of devices used in patients undergoing fetoscopic neural tube defect repair.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who elect to undergo fetoscopic neural tube defect repair

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not elect to undergo fetoscopic neural tube defect repair
